craft_notes: Sthāyin: utkrānti unit 48. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 2. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: Thus supreme this, not uninitiated before, should read thus: as and sa
mayin in wood, in clod, or mantra-joining.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ityevaṃparametannādīkṣitāgre paṭhediti yathā ca samayī kāṣṭhe loṣṭe vā mantrayojanām
